lines: AQ08001	PACE AMERICAN	TRAILER	2003	WHEELS	PACE AMERICAN, INC.	20080618	20081029		PACE AMERICAN 573 RETRACTION	BY LETTER DATED NOVEMBER 8, 2007, PACE AMERICAN NOTIFIED NHTSA THAT A DEFECT WHICH RELATED TO MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY EXISTED IN 180 TO 315 SUBJECT VEHICLES MANUFACTURED WITH DEFECTIVE ALUMINUM WHEELS SUPPLIED BY TREDIT TIRE & WHEEL CO. (TREDIT) WHICH COULD BREAK APART, DEFLATING THE TIRE AND RESULTING IN PROPERTY DAMAGE OR PERSONAL INJURY. SUBSEQUENTLY, BY A LETTER DATED APRIL 22, 2008 PACE INFORMED NHTSA THAT ITS NOVEMBER 8TH DECISION WAS MADE IN ERROR AND REQUESTED A RESCINDMENT OF THEIR PART 573 DEFECT REPORT STATING THAT THEIR DECISION WAS BASED ON ONE WARRANTY CLAIM, WHICH PACE LATER DETERMINED TO BE THE RESULT OF OVERLOADING.AFTER FURTHER CONSIDERATION OF THE INFORMATION PACE SUPPLIED IN ITS FILINGS, AND THE LIMITATION OF AGENCY RESOURCES, NHTSA HAS DECIDED TO CLOSE THIS INVESTIGATION.

AQ09001	APEXCONE	APX9004	9999	EXTERIOR LIGHTING	CARFILO	20090326	20090706	05E069000	HID REPLACEMENT KIT RECALL CAMPAIGNS	RMD IDENTIFIED SEVERAL HID REPLACEMENT LIGHTING RECALL CAMPAIGNS THAT APPEARED NOT TO HAVE BEEN CONDUCTED OR CONDUCTED IMPROPERLY.THE RECALL CAMPAIGNS AND MANUFACTURERS SUBJECT TO THIS INVESTIGATION WERE IDENTIFIED IN THE OPENING RESUME.RMD ISSUED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO EACH MANUFACTURER INQUIRING INTO THE STATUS OF EACH RECALL AND REQUESTING DOCUMENTATION WHERE NEEDED.WHERE THOSE LETTERS WERE EITHER RETURNED UNDELIVERED, OR A RESPONSE WAS NOT FORTHCOMING, NHTSA ATTEMPTED TO CONTACT EACH MANUFACTURER BY PHONE OR BY MAILING TO ALTERNATIVE ADDRESSES.WITH THE EXCEPTION OF THREE RECALL CAMPAIGNS, RMD WAS SUCCESSFUL IN CONTACTING THE MANUFACTURER, CONFIRMING THE STATUS OF A RECALL CAMPAIGN, COLLECTING MISSING OR CORRECTED RECALL DOCUMENTATION AND, WHERE NECESSARY, HAVING THE MANUFACTURER INITIATE ITS OWNER NOTIFICATION PROGRAM. THE THREE RECALL CAMPAIGNS FOR WHICH RMD WAS UNABLE TO CONFIRM THE CORRECT CONDUCT OF THE RECALL WERE 07E-084 (WU'S INTERNATIONAL TRADE), 06E-066 (AUTO PAW TRADING, INC.) AND 06E-080 (LUCENT STYLES, INC.)IN 07E-084 AND 06E-066, RMD WAS UNABLE TO CONTACT THE MANUFACTURER AFTER NUMEROUS ATTEMPTS AND SUSPECTS THAT THOSE MANUFACTURERS ARE NO LONGER IN BUSINESS.IN 06E-066, A REPRESENTATIVE OF AUTO PAW TRADING CLAIMED THAT THE MANUFACTURER HAD TERMINATED ITS BUSINESS AND COULD NOT PRODUCE RECORDS TO SHOW ITS CONDUCTING OF THE CAMPAIGN.THE AGENCY HAS DECIDED THAT FURTHER AND SCARCE RESOURCES ARE NOT WARRANTED IN PURSUING THE FEW MANUFACTURERS WHOSE EXISTENCE IS NO LONGER CERTAIN.THIS AQ IS CLOSED.
